rationale: Generic chart-shader work. The Skia chart composer reports the chart's tangent in device orientation, so a chart drawn through a rotation is lit on screen; untransformed draws are unchanged. Pulp-owned view code draws chart shaders and named presets on Fader tracks (a stadium along the track, turned a quarter for a vertical fader), with the stock thumb over a chart-only track and a body shader owning the value otherwise; widgets that draw no chart refuse one; the widget gallery gains five fader tracks. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the canvas change when the targets adopt the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart reports tan in device orientation'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'fader chart presets are lit on screen on vertical and horizontal tracks'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'fader chart presets show the fader.s value'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'faders without a chart render as before'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'widget gallery shows chart shader presets on fader tracks'
